skill_name: Explain why proper nutrition is important for healthy living.
workflow: Proper nutrition is important for healthy living because it helps to ensure the body is getting all of the energy and essential nutrients it needs to function properly. Eating a balanced diet that includes a variety of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, and healthy fats helps to provide the body with essential vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients that it needs in order to be healthy and strong. Additionally, proper nutrition can help keep the body's metabolism running efficientl
